recommendation_summary: The reply recommends one dead-man heartbeat: nightly-sync pings it on success, and it alerts the user if no ping arrives.

labels.Requirements and who asked: Alert within a day on fail or silence with no log reading (user need for nightly-sync); Synology Docker central log was user suggestion only.
labels.Deleted: Central log on Synology, Docker logging stack, log aggregation for manual review.
labels.Bottleneck: No detection of missing success, crashes before email left four nights silent.
labels.Checked myself: Single cron job on edna at 03:00, email only on finish, four startup crashes on expired token with no email, no other alerting today, Synology available, you will not read logs.

note: The reply recommends a single heartbeat alert, explicitly rejects the Synology/Docker log stack, and its four record lines all come before the recommendation and cite only facts from the situation.
